name: git-it-started
description: A hands-on introduction to modern Git workflows.

scripts.build: rm -rf _site && mkdir -p _site && reveal-md git.md --css style.css --static _site/en --static-dirs=static --absolute-url https://b3n4kh.github.io/git-it-started/en/ && reveal-md git_de.md --css style.css --static _site/de --static-dirs=static --absolute-url https://b3n4kh.github.io/git-it-started/de/ && cp index.html landing.css favicon.ico _site/ && touch _site/.nojekyll
scripts.test: npm run build && test -f _site/index.html && test -f _site/en/index.html && test -f _site/de/index.html && test -f _site/.nojekyll && test -f _site/en/static/git_lc.png && test -f _site/de/static/git_lc.png && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const [file, text] of [['_site/index.html','Git it Started'],['_site/en/index.html','A practical introduction to Git'],['_site/de/index.html','Ein kompakter Einstieg in Git']]) if (!fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8').includes(text)) process.exit(1)"
